Required_For: Informational advice with no account/device change
Not_Accepted_As_Sole_Proof: Do not expose private account data

Required_For: View ticket status, asset association, non-sensitive checks
Not_Accepted_As_Sole_Proof: Employee ID or email alone is not verification

Required_For: Password reset, account unlock, MFA re-enrollment, phone/authenticator change
Accepted_Evidence_or_Service: IdP challenge using a previously registered authenticator, passkey, security key, or corporate SSO reauthentication
Not_Accepted_As_Sole_Proof: No manager name, phone digits, start date, or last login are context only, not proof

Required_For: No registered factor, lost all factors, suspicious activity, account takeover indicators
Accepted_Evidence_or_Service: Dedicated identity recovery service or supervised human identity-proofing workflow with approval and audit
Not_Accepted_As_Sole_Proof: Bot must not improvise questions or accept screenshots of IDs in chat

Required_For: Privileged access, MFA bypass, service account secret, device wipe, external sensitive access
Accepted_Evidence_or_Service: V2/V3 plus policy approval, least privilege, time limit, and second-person authorization where configured
Not_Accepted_As_Sole_Proof: Bot cannot approve or execute solely from request

Accepted_Evidence_or_Service: verification_id, status, assurance_level, method_family, timestamp, expiry, risk_flags, verifier_system
Not_Accepted_As_Sole_Proof: Never store secret, OTP value, recovery code, password, biometric, or full authenticator
